feed.en: Parasites are animals or plants that live on another animal and feed from them.
feed.zh: parasites(寄生虫)指的是寄生在其他动物身上，并从中获取养分的动物或植物。

feed.en: It also required government organization capable of planning and feeding and managing labor forces.
feed.zh: 它还需要能够规划、供给和管理劳动力的政府组织能力。

feed.en: A parasite is an animal or plant that lives on another animal and feeds on it.
feed.zh: parasite(寄生虫)是指寄生在其他动物身上，并以其为食的动物或植物。

feed.en: Pies and stews, puddings, and dishes that could feed an entire family.
feed.zh: 馅饼、炖菜、布丁，以及能喂饱全家人的菜肴。

feed.en: On top of this, personalized feeds like your TikTok feed or your Instagram feed, create echo chambers.
feed.zh: 最重要的是，诸如TikTok或Instagram上的个性化信息流会制造回音室。

fear.en: Whether they feared arrest or were seeking military support from abroad, historians still debate.
fear.zh: 历史学家们至今仍在争论他们是因为害怕被捕，还是为了在国外寻求军事支持。

fear.en: Fear spread like wildfire, and soon, people saw witches everywhere because they expected to.
fear.zh: 恐惧如野火般蔓延，很快，人们到处都能看到女巫，因为他们心中本就期待着女巫的出现。

fear.en: Bubbles are driven by excitement, speculation, and sometimes the fear of missing out.
fear.zh: 泡沫是由兴奋、投机以及有时对错失恐惧的心理驱动的。

fear.en: Here, he would be free from the modern world he feared and hated.
fear.zh: 在这里，他将摆脱他所恐惧和恨之入骨的现代世界。

fear.en: Well done. The amygdala is associated with our processing of fear and anxiety.
fear.zh: 干得好。杏仁核与我们对恐惧和焦虑的处理有关。

female.en: Here, two female listeners of BBC World Service programme People Fixing the World share their experiences.
female.zh: 在这里，BBC世界服务部节目《拯救世界的人们》的两名女性听众分享了她们的经历。

female.en: He appeared in public dressed as Apollo, Mercury, even Venus, the female goddess of love.
female.zh: 他在公众场合打扮成 Apollo、Mercury 甚至爱之女神 Venus。

female.en: And in 2017 she won the title Best Female Chef in the World.
female.zh: 在2017年，她赢得了“世界最佳女厨师”的称号。

female.en: She was the first female professor at the Sorbonne and the first woman to win Nobel Prizes.
female.zh: 她是索邦大学第一位女教授，也是第一位获得诺贝尔奖的女性。

female.en: Male and female pandas need a little help to make babies, and zoos can provide this help.
female.zh: 雄性和雌性大熊猫需要一点帮助来生宝宝，而动物园可以提供这种帮助。

feature.en: For many people in Woldham, Jason included, debt was an ordinary feature of daily life.
feature.zh: 对于沃尔德姆的许多人来说，包括杰森在内，负债是日常生活的一个普通特征。

feature.en: I gave my speech. I was on TV. They featured me on the local news.
feature.zh: 我发表了演讲。我还上了电视。当地新闻对我进行了报道。

feature.en: Part and parcel means to be an essential element or feature of something.
feature.zh: Part and parcel 的意思是成为某事的重要组成部分或特征。

feature.en: They're huge and they've got cool features, like gyms or home cinemas.
feature.zh: 它们规模宏大，而且有一些很酷的设施，比如健身房或家庭影院。

feature.en: To be part and parcel of something means to be an essential or integral feature of it.
feature.zh: 成为某事的 part and parcel 意味着它是该事物必不可少的或不可分割的特征。

feasible.en: We can also describe something as feasible or unfeasible.
feasible.zh: 我们也可以将某事描述为可行的（feasible）或不可行的（unfeasible）。

feasible.en: It comes from the adjective feasible. For example, I could say that I think it’s feasible for us to finish this podcast in six minutes.
feasible.zh: 它源于形容词 feasible（可行的）。例如，我可以认为我们在六分钟内完成这个播客是可行的。

fertile.en: One of the most useful soils is clay, a dense, smooth soil which is very fertile but sticky.
fertile.zh: 最有用的土壤之一是粘土，这是一种致密、光滑的土壤，非常肥沃但有粘性。

fertile.en: This is also a very fertile region, which saw the rise of farming communities thousands of years ago.
fertile.zh: 这也是一个非常肥沃的地区，几千年前就见证了农耕社区的崛起。

fell.en: Anyone who fell outside those categories still had no alternative to the workhouse.
fell.zh: 任何落入这些类别之外的人仍然没有替代济贫院的选择。

fell.en: By the 4th century CE, Byzantium fell under the full control of the Roman Empire.
fell.zh: 到公元4世纪，拜占庭完全落入了罗马帝国的控制之下。

fell.en: Cities grew and economies expanded, and over the centuries, many different dynasties rose and fell.
fell.zh: 城市不断发展，经济不断扩张，在过去的几个世纪里，许多不同的朝代兴衰更替。

fell.en: Interest rates fell, not just in the UK, but across much of the developed world.
fell.zh: 不仅在英国，在整个发达世界的大部分地区，利率都在下降。

fell.en: Without that, most of the cases fell apart because there was no evidence.
fell.zh: 没有了这些，大部分案件都由于缺乏证据而土崩瓦解。

fellow.en: The first was a fellow student, and the woman who would become his wife, Usha.
fellow.zh: 第一个是他的同学，也就是后来成为他妻子的乌莎（Usha）。

fellow.en: He arrived in 1961, after being recruited by a fellow Frenchman to fight for the secessionists.
fellow.zh: 1961年，他在被一名法国同胞招募去为分离主义分子作战后抵达了那里。

fellow.en: A real, raw, lived experience of a part of America that most of his professors and fellow students had never seen.
fellow.zh: 一个真实的、赤裸裸的、亲身经历过的美国社会切面，而他的大多数教授和同学从未亲眼见过。

fellow.en: He produced original research while still a student and was elected a fellow of the college at a very young age.
fellow.zh: 他还在求学期间便产出了原创性的研究成果，并在很年轻时就当选为该学院的院士。

fellow.en: An unfortunate truth about humanity is that we humans are capable of committing acts against our fellow humans that are utterly inhumane.
fellow.zh: 关于人性，有一个令人遗憾的事实：人类有能力对同类做出极其残忍、毫无人性的事情。

festival.en: There is even a small festival held in Covent Garden each May to mark it.
festival.zh: 每年五月，考芬园甚至还会举办一个小型的节日来庆祝它。

festival.en: No longer would festivals and planting seasons drift aimlessly through the year.
festival.zh: 节日和播种季节将不再漫无目的地在一年中漂移。

festival.en: Spring festivals were being celebrated in the middle of winter, and the practical workings of Roman society were falling apart.
festival.zh: 春季节日竟然在仲冬时节庆祝，罗马社会的实际运作正在崩溃。

festival.en: There are festivals, murals, markets, that all celebrate Mexico’s heritage, while technology and businesses and innovation are pushing the city towards the future.
festival.zh: 这里有庆祝墨西哥遗产的各种节日、壁画和集市，而科技、商业和创新则推动着这座城市大步迈向未来。

festival.en: A town council in South Wales removed a Punch and Judy show from a local festival on the grounds that it was, in their words, "too violent and contained inappropriate hitting".
festival.zh: 南威尔士的一个镇议会以该节目“过于暴力且包含不当击打”为由，将一场 Punch and Judy 演出从当地的节日中取消了。

fence.en: A pale, P-A-L-E, as a noun, is literally a fenced boundary, an enclosure.
fence.zh: “Pale”这个词作为名词，字面意思是栅栏边界或围场。

fence.en: Landowners enclosed common land. Fences and boundaries were built around the land.
fence.zh: 地主们圈占了公有地。土地周围建起了围栏和边界。

fence.en: Almost overnight, barbed wire fences appeared across the city.
fence.zh: 几乎在一夜之间，带刺的铁丝网栅栏出现在城市各处。

fence.en: Salem was small, only about 500 people, so news travelled fast, from house to house, whispered over fences and church pews.
fence.zh: 塞勒姆很小，只有大约500人，所以消息传播得极快，挨家挨户，在篱笆和教堂长椅旁低声耳语。

feedback.en: ‘Cause feedback is really important. A growth mindset involves being willing to change, right?
feedback.zh: 因为反馈真的很重要。成长型思维包含着愿意改变的意愿，对吧？

feedback.en: That brings us to the third key to becoming an expert: timely feedback.
feedback.zh: 这就引出了成为专家的第三个关键：及时的反馈。

feedback.en: But it’s not just about repetition… it’s about intentional and consistent repetition with feedback.
feedback.zh: 但这不仅仅是重复……而是带着反馈的有意识且持续的重复。

feedback.en: How could I do things differently? Is there someone who could give me useful feedback?
feedback.zh: 我该如何用不同的方式做事？有没有谁能给我提供有用的反馈？

feedback.en: Third, find an English teacher or someone to give positive feedback when you do well.
feedback.zh: 第三，找一位英语老师或某人在你表现好时给予积极的反馈。

fearful.en: Odysseus does finally return home, but he must do so in secret, fearful that revealing his identity too soon would put him in mortal danger.
fearful.zh: 奥德修斯最终确实回到了家，但他必须秘密行事，因为他担心过早暴露身份会让自己陷入致命的危险之中。

feast.en: He would invite senators to dine with him, serve them the finest food, and then, at the height of the feast, casually order their deaths.
feast.zh: 他会邀请元老院议员与他共进晚餐，为他们提供最精美的食物，然后在宴会高潮时，随口下令将他们处死。

federal.en: Australia is a federal country, which means it has states with their own governments.
federal.zh: 澳大利亚是一个联邦制国家，这意味着它拥有各自政府的州。

federal.en: But while this anonymity made prosecutions difficult, it also gave federal agents an opening.
federal.zh: 虽然这种匿名性让起诉变得困难，但也给联邦探员提供了一个突破口。

federal.en: And there was immediate confusion among federal employees, the government workers who received the email.
federal.zh: 收到邮件的联邦雇员也就是政府工作人员中立刻产生了困惑。

federal.en: And today, both English and French are the official languages of Canada at the federal level.
federal.zh: 而今天，英语和法语都是加拿大联邦层面的官方语言。

federal.en: Critics pointed out that Musk’s access to federal systems could benefit his companies while harming competitors.
federal.zh: 批评人士指出，Musk 访问联邦系统的权限可能会使他的公司受益，同时损害竞争对手的利益。

fearless.en: He also cultivated a very specific image of himself: the fearless leader.
fearless.zh: 他还精心打造了一个非常独特的个人形象：无所畏惧的领袖。

fearless.en: He was fearless on the battleground, had been injured multiple times, and had the scars to prove it.
fearless.zh: 他在战场上无所畏惧，曾多次受伤，身上的伤疤就是证明。

fearless.en: But being certain of your abilities and trusting your skills is not the same thing as being perfect and fearless.
fearless.zh: 但确信自己的能力并信任自己的技能，并不等于完美无缺和无所畏惧。

fearless.en: Many people think confidence means being fearless.
fearless.zh: 许多人认为自信意味着无所畏惧。

fever.en: But this meant that many neighborhoods were overcrowded and diseases like yellow fever and smallpox could spread easily.
fever.zh: 但这意味许多社区过于拥挤，黄热病和天花等疾病极易传播。

fever.en: Now, this was in the early 20th century, and just as his obsession was reaching a fever pitch, Europe descended into the chaos of the First World War.
fever.zh: 当时正值 20 世纪初，正当他对这件事的痴迷达到狂热顶点时，欧洲陷入了一战的混乱之中。

fever.en: He claimed to have shot enormous 20-metre-long anacondas, to have encountered tribes that no other European had seen, and to have a near-superhuman resistance to the fevers and diseases that ravaged his fellow explorers.
fever.zh: 他声称自己射杀过长达 20 米的巨大森蚺，遇到过其他欧洲人从未见过的部落，并且对折磨同行探险家的热病和疾病具有近乎超人的抵抗力。

feather.en: This effect was connected to Kukulcan, who was a feathered serpent deity worshiped by the Maya.
feather.zh: 这种视觉效果与库库尔坎有关，他是玛雅人崇拜的羽蛇神。

fertilizer.en: Phosphate is a very valuable mineral, which is used to make fertilizer.
fertilizer.zh: 磷酸盐是一种非常有价值的矿物质，用于制造化肥。

fertilizer.en: Fertilizers are used by farmers to improve the growth of their crops.
fertilizer.zh: 化肥被农民用来促进作物的生长。
